create_Cell_neural_architecture_search: create a Cell module with genotype operations for neural architecture search forward pass
create_AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR_auxiliary_clas: create an AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR module for auxiliary classification on 8x8 feature maps during training
